Background-only; not used for any spatial boundary, metric, or formal planning conclusion.

Background conceptual grounding only: Marx (Theses on Feuerbach - philosophers have only interpreted the world; alienated labour; Grundrisse 'General Intellect'), Mumford (The City in History - city as container/magnet for human association), Jacobs (The Death and Life of Great American Cities - streets for people), Lefebvre (The Production of Space), Ashihara Yoshinori (The Aesthetics of the Street - D/H ratio 1:1 to 1:2 as the comfortable street enclosure range), Gehl (Life Between Buildings - 20-25 m as the distance at which faces can be read). Philosophical and spatial-standard spine for 'AI-and-people / human-centered'; not a regulatory authority and not a source of measured site values.

Tsinghua-MIT viewpoint in Nature Computational Science: LLM-driven urban planning framework as 'intelligent planning assistant', human-AI closed loop (conceptualization-generation-evaluation). Backs the 'AI serves people, not replaces' thesis; academic, not a spatial authority.

Yin Zhi (THU professor, expert解读 Central Urban Work Conference): 'people-centered livable city', 'from rent-driven to people-city model'. Authoritative people-centered urbanism grounding for the AI-and-people spine.

Jiang Hongfeng (Marxist political-economy): digital labour alienation ('seeing objects not people'), 'labour-life-city' synergy, 'free all-round development of people'. Contemporary Marxist grounding for the alienation-labour thread in the theoretical spine.

Shanghai Yangpu District 15th Five-Year planning: 'two axes, two zones, one center, one island' innovation spatial pattern; 'people build the people's city'; complete communities. Real Shanghai district-planning sample for comparative governance-language reference.

Beijing AI Origin Community (OPC) real operations: 1000+ AI scientists, 13k developers, 400+ firms (74% AI), Origin Tower opened 2026-03, OPC (one-person-company) concept. Empirical anchor for PROV-KEY-002; also reveals the submission's provisional rectangle is NOT yet anchored to the real OPC footprint - requires honest offset note.
Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park: about 9 km along the old railway, being built as a heritage park. Real heritage-park fact underpinning the ground-stitching belt and cultural anchor.
Beijing 14th Five-Year urban renewal action: stock-quality-improvement, micro-renewal leverages big livelihood. Context for renewal-vs-greenfield framing of the design scope.

sources.usage: OPC (one-person-company) movement context: Chengdu offers the highest compute subsidy plus three years of free workspaces; Beijing OPC communities follow a high start-up-density route. Context for Origin Community OPC positioning.

Approved regulatory detailed plan (block level) along the Jing-Zhang Heritage Park (HD00-1601 et al., 2024-2035), announced by Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources (Aug 2026): ~1668.2 ha, 9 blocks, one-belt-one-axis-two-centers-multiple-nodes structure; Dazhongsi center and Wudaokou center; green public space leading renewal; old-plant conversion and inefficient-building renewal for large models/agents/embodied AI; Beijing Satellite Manufacturing Factory park case. Spatial-structure and renewal-principle evidence only; not a boundary/redline source.

Jing-Zhang Heritage Park Phase II opened 2026-08-06 (Haidian District Landscaping Bureau): ~9 km / ~53 ha linear green space from Xizhimen to North 5th Ring, serving 70 communities / ~450k residents; Phase I ~2.4 km; three-paths-one-green seamless slow system linked to Huilongguan bike-exclusive road; fences removed, 9 branch roads opened; south community-vitality segment restores ~2.4 km of 1909 track and Sidaokou node. Empirical anchor for ground-stitching narrative; not a boundary source.

Haidian released world-first AI innovation street concept at June 2024 Zhongguancun Forum: Wudaokou and Dazhongsi as pilot zones over ~53 km2 city agent; AI Origin Community at Dongsheng Tower on Wudaokou; 'AI full-scene empowerment first city' ambition; 1,000 firms/100-billion cluster by 2026. Positioning and target evidence; not spatial/regulatory authority.

Zhongguancun Science City AI Full-Scene Empowerment Action Plan (2024-2026) released at 2024 Beijing AI Ecosystem Conference: main battle-ground/platform/engine; first AI innovation street; 100 benchmark model products and 100 demonstration cases by 2026. District policy evidence for AI industry positioning.

Haidian 15th Five-Year Plan outline (released 2026-04): vanguard status of the capital; world-leading S&T park; GDP about 26% of Beijing (late 14th-FYP); 2030 GDP doubling vs 2020 base; R&D intensity ~10%. Macro base-line evidence for regional synergy chapter.

2024 Beijing Zhiyuan Conference report (Haidian planning world-first AI street): Haidian hosts >80% of the city's AI scholars, >70% of AI2000 top scholars, >70% of registered large-model firms, >60% of AI-licensed invention patents, 1,000+ AI firms (2/3 of city, 1/6 of country). Statistical evidence; not spatial authority.

Service Equivalence Baseline SEB v0.5.0 (still usable when AI is switched off): five-field node schema (ai_off_path/human_handoff/gate_id/operating_mode/responsible_role), denominators never drop failed samples, L0-L4 ladder with gates G0-G3 (downgrade allowed), eight stop/resume rules, AI permission boundary, dual-entry handover ledger; CC BY-SA 4.0 granted, open for adoption. Adopted by this proposal as criteria skeleton for AI scenarios; no rating/approval claimed.

Full text of the international solicitation prequalification announcement (reposted): three scope levels with textual four-directions and areas (43.6 sq km overall study, ~11.4 sq km overall design, 368.4 ha key detailed design incl. Zhongzhiyuan 192.1 ha, AI Origin Community 104.3 ha, Dazhongsi 72.0 ha); three-zone-two-wing spatial structure; design tasks incl. naming scheme and logo design; optional self-selected scenario area (AI+ software/info, medical, education, legal, life services); process: 5 prequalified teams, ~100 design days, 3 winning schemes. Complement to OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT.

Beijing Daily via People's Daily Beijing (2026-08-12): HD00-1601 et al. street-level regulatory detailed plan approved; green public space leading regional urban renewal; new basic education/medical/elderly-care/culture/sports public service facilities; 15-minute community service circle integrating life and innovation circles; higher road network density; the true origin of the Jing-Zhang Railway at Liucun 60th Bridge (south of Beijing North Station).

AI Origin Community progress report (2026-04): selected 2026-01-05 as one of Beijing's first batch of AI innovation blocks; 30+ universities/research institutes, 230+ AI enterprises, 100k AI students; ten-minute innovation circle; Origin party nights (2026-03-26~29, 2000+ AI youth); Zhipu AI listed on HKEX 2026-01-08 (first global LLM stock); Shengshu Tech A+ round >600M CNY (2026-02); Xingdong Era 1B CNY strategic round (2026-03); BAAI FlagOS 2.0 (2026-03-27). Evidence for the middle-core near-university outcomes positioning.

Helsinki 2023: UrbanistAI platform used in two participatory planning workshops (15-member citizen committee + local business owners); generative AI turns citizens' ideas into visual planning imagery. International reference: AI-assisted imagination in community governance halls; not a binding precedent.

Toronto Quayside/Sidewalk Labs post-mortem: control over smart-city data flows and IP is power; industry-government role separation plus transparent accountability required; policymakers need data-trust/IP-license literacy. International counter-example underpinning this proposal's SEB dual-entry handover ledger and AI permission boundary.

ITU-T case study of Seoul's Smart Seoul 2015: citizen participation plus digital infrastructure first-mover, early approach largely technology-driven. International contrast to highlight this proposal's people-first governance path.

Maintainer comment naming the eight pilot-readiness contract fields (baseline and source; observation target, sample and time window; success and stop conditions; responsible actor; human-equivalent service; review cycle; retention and deletion proof; objection and appeal entry) plus three boundaries: in-package PASS is not field performance, a repository snapshot is not a deployment, and a missing baseline may freeze the field but must not be filled with invented numbers.
